easy_finite_domain.policy: deduplicate by mathematical givens across source masks, fields, banks and levels; these counts are not additive

bounded_source_profile_exception.policy: Evidence-only opaque numerical distractor profiles. Current replenishment uses the validated method-derived complete banks and existing AC parallelogram/AC-or-BD general-quadrilateral masks. BD parallelogram source masks are classified but not declared supported generation templates in version 5. No source bank fidelity claim extends to those newly captured masks.
bounded_source_profile_exception.impact: No difficulty is blocked: each supported level has at least five distinct validated same-method tasks. No new operation is introduced.

rounding_grader_constraints: Digits and optional decimal point required for normal blanks; leading plus and equivalent arithmetic expressions rejected by the actual engine.
